body:
# Author moves processor headroom/phase measurement before D3 implementation

Author asks to prioritize actual eZ80 headroom and native VDP phase measurements ahead of scheduler implementation;120Hz physics remains target. Current matched fixture only drives transport from eZ80 and batches four finite VDP ticks per frame; it does not measure actual eZ80 player/input/rules cost or autonomous cadence.

Located the fuller fixture the Author recalled: R27-05 in AgonArcade rally-game/src/main.cpp, include/timing_fixture.hpp and docs/tasks/RALLY-27/timing/. Fuji attract-derived traffic/scrolling panorama/signs/player/HUD/title/audio, centerline/pace lock, explicit collision checks without damage. Existing optional PRT hotloop/geometry/submission totals compiled but were not runtime-qualified; R27T ordered VDP microsecond markers/completed swaps exist. Simplified attract player advancement is not actual player-physics cost. This is preserved direct-eZ80 baseline, not already integrated full-scene native composition.

Rally tasks TRF-001-54 inventory complete;55 measures actual eZ80 player/input/rules CPU isolated from UART/CTS/VBlank waits against8.333ms per step;56 measures current native VDP finite physics/contact, geometry, drawing/presentation and fixture/transport overhead, reusing suitable timing/data-output facilities. Exact same bytes required across Flexe/Console8. Current amendment is priority/documentation/source investigation only; no new code/build/run or firmware/SDK implementation delegation. Any concrete runtime timing hook request will come through this mailbox with owner/interface scope. Prior D3 ownership proposal remains proposed, not assigned implementation. No reply/action needed for priority notice.
